We conduct a human annotation study. Two annotators are employed from the author list and be required to label each sample and its four consistency transformations.
guideline: Annotators were asked to label each original sample and its transformed versions to assess whether the meaning was preserved.

Both of them received an advanced degree in computer science. The Inter-Annotator Agreement score is calculated to be 0.98, based on an evaluation of 40 samples and their 160 transformed samples. The average consistency score for human annotators is 0.975, indicating that our method successfully preserves the original meaning in most cases.
